resolvedGaps.description: Definition vs Instance separation in structural assembly models
resolvedGaps.resolution: Enforced PartDefinition/PartInstance and ComponentDefinition/ComponentInstance typing with mandatory definitionId reference in StructuralElementRegistry.

resolvedGaps.description: Spatial placement transforms mutating canonical state from UI viewers
resolvedGaps.resolution: Implemented StructuralPlacementEngine with explicit unauthorized transform mutation barrier blocking UI/visualization callers.
Implemented StructuralConstraintEngine detecting Parallel vs Perpendicular contradictions and cross-configuration constraint leaks.

resolvedGaps.description: P3 Architectural interface alignment with physical structural connections
resolvedGaps.resolution: Implemented StructuralInterfaceEngine mapping structural interfaces to bolted/welded joints, detecting unmapped interfaces and orphan joints.
